title: Large microwave generation from current-driven magnetic vortex oscillators in magnetic tunnel junctions
subject: Physics
question: What are the key quantitative findings visible in this chart?
original_caption: The plot displays the integrated microwave power (in nW) as a function of the out-of-plane magnetic field (in kOe) for a direct current of -5 mA. The magnetic field is swept from -8 kOe to +8 kOe. The integrated power remains near zero across most of the field range, except for a sharp, narrow peak occurring between approximately 3.7 kOe and 4.3 kOe.
